title: Federated style aware transformer aggregation of representations
abstract: arXiv:2511.18841v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Personalized Federated Learning (PFL) faces persistent challenges, including domain heterogeneity from diverse client data, data imbalance due to skewed participation, and strict communication constraints. Traditional federated learning often lacks personalization, as a single global model cannot capture client-specific characteristics, leading to biased predictions and poor generalization, especially for clients with highly divergent data distributions.   To address these issues, we propose FedSTAR, a style-aware federated learning framework that disentangles client-specific style factors from shared content representations. FedSTAR aggregates class-wise prototypes using a Transformer-based attention mechanism, allowing the server to adaptively weight client contributions while preserving personalization. translated_title: 联邦式风格感知的Transformer表示聚合
translated_abstract: 个性化联邦学习（PFL）面临持续的挑战，包括来自多样化客户端数据的领域异构性、因参与倾斜导致的数据不平衡，以及严格的通信约束。传统联邦学习往往缺乏个性化，因为单一的全局模型无法捕捉客户端特有的特征，从而导致预测偏差和泛化能力差，尤其是对于数据分布高度差异化的客户端。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了FedSTAR，一种风格感知的联邦学习框架，它将客户端特定的风格因素从共享的内容表示中解耦出来。FedSTAR使用基于Transformer的注意力机制聚合类别级原型，使服务器能够在保持个性化的同时自适应地为客户端贡献加权。此外，通过交换紧凑的原型和风格向量而非完整的模型参数，FedSTAR显著……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: FedSTAR提出了一种风格感知的个性化联邦学习框架，通过将客户端风格因素与内容表示解耦、利用Transformer注意力机制聚合类别原型，并仅交换紧凑的原型与风格向量而非完整模型参数，从而在保持个性化的同时有效应对数据异构、参与不平衡和通信约束。
en_tdlr: FedSTAR is a style-aware personalized federated learning framework that disentangles client-specific style factors from content representations, aggregates class-wise prototypes via Transformer-based attention, and exchanges compact prototypes and style vectors instead of full model parameters to address heterogeneity, data imbalance, and communication constraints.
